summary: IDS feed s052_single is degraded: 9.0% TCP packet loss (143/1583 packets) exceeds 1% threshold, causing incomplete flows for IDS inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, truncation, tunnels, VLAN, encryption, oversize, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream SPAN/mirror or packet broker is dropping packets under load - 9% of TCP packets show gaps/retransmissions indicating buffer exhaustion or oversubscription before the IDS. Tool overload check is healthy, so loss is not at IDS ingress policer but in the SPAN/broker path.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload and both directions for TCP stream reassembly and signature matching. Missing segments break reassembly, cause false negatives and missed exploit/C2 detection, directly reducing detection coverage.

params.tap_type: passive optical/copper TAP with packet broker buffering

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy unlike SPAN which drops when source exceeds destination or switch buffers fill. Replacing SPAN with TAP and feeding via broker with adequate buffering eliminates the 9% loss and restores complete TCP streams for IDS.
